about: Video 005 The Dunya: every shot reuses a shot of video 002 (kind = 002's shot; src = the 002 time window in seconds played over this shot, slowed; default = 002's whole shot). craneUp = pastMasjid with a new camera rising into the sky. Every cut is a soft dissolve through rain on glass.

shots.why: Don't worry about the dunya: rain running down his dark window
he walks home alone in the heavy rain
the phone glowing in the dark room
the night street: the bus pulls away in the rain
provision is written: he stands still in the rain as the crowd rushes past
don't make it bigger than it is: the windowsill, rain on the glass
keep the dunya in your hand: past the rows of graves in the rain
if it goes, it only left your hand: fog rolls over the grave
that's how you'll live happy: men walking calmly in a line under umbrellas
57:22 No disaster strikes: the window, the rain
the room, the clock on the wall
or among yourselves: the prayer beads slip off the nightstand
in a register: he lies awake at night
before We bring it into being: the dark room, rain on the window behind him
he walks on alone in the rain
his phone drops into a puddle
a father sits on the bed in the dark, holding prayer beads
indeed that, for Allah, is easy: lightning shows the empty room
men raise their hands in du'a in the rain
57:23 so you don't despair: he walks toward the masjid's warm light in the rain
the warm light spilling from the door
a slow crane up from the masjid door into the rainy sky
